asserts: no numbers to assert; instead (a) all 14 section references are verified against the live 03_methods.md heading list at build time - number AND title - so a renumbered Methods breaks the build; (b) every box label is checked to fit its own box
gate_branch: burned-landcover gate shown with its rejecting branch; Kozan 2023 drawn as negative control in the grey/dashed style used in Fig. 1, connected to the gate by a headless dashed connector so the figure does not imply it flows onward into any model
routing: orthogonal only - every connector is a right-angled elbow with square corners; input products merge on a collector bus; the three lanes in the column 4->5 gap are reused only where vertical runs cannot overlap in y, so no two connectors share a segment
palette: Okabe-Ito accents on grey; neutral grey for the control; no red-green
